title: Integrated Optics: An Introduction
significance: Proposed combining optical components on one substrate as an integrated optical circuit; credited with launching integrated optics.

era: E1 1960-1969 laser, nonlinear optics, integrated-optics idea
title: Stimulated Optical Radiation in Ruby
significance: Report of the first operating laser, a ruby laser at Hughes Research Laboratories (operated 1960-05-16).

era: E1 1960-1969 laser, nonlinear optics, integrated-optics idea
title: Coupled Wave Theory for Thick Hologram Gratings
significance: Coupled-wave theory of Bragg diffraction in thick (volume) gratings, transmission and reflection; basis for analytic grating efficiency formulas.

era: E1 1960-1969 laser, nonlinear optics, integrated-optics idea
title: MODES OF PROPAGATING LIGHT WAVES IN THIN DEPOSITED SEMICONDUCTOR FILMS
significance: Prism-film coupler used to excite and measure guided modes of deposited thin films; start of experimental thin-film integrated optics.

era: E1 1960-1969 laser, nonlinear optics, integrated-optics idea
title: Dielectric-fibre surface waveguides for optical frequencies
venue: Proceedings of the Institution of Electrical Engineers
dri: K. C. Kao; George A. Hockham
significance: Proposed glass fibre as an optical communication waveguide, viable if losses fell below 20 dB/km; Kao shared the 2009 Nobel Prize in Physics.

significance: Phased array of bent waveguides used as a focusing and dispersive planar component: the PHASAR/AWG concept, two years before NTT's AWG.

title: Optical frequency comb generation from a monolithic microresonator
